headline: TELUS Q2 Earnings Fall Y/Y on Digital Weakness, Outlook Cut
summary: TU cut its 2026 outlook and reset its dividend after weaker Digital results, lower revenues and a C$2.14B impairment drove a steep quarterly loss.

headline: DTE ties rate stability to data center projects as large-load pipeline remains steady
summary: The company’s $30 billion electric utility capital investment plan was unchanged from the first quarter, officials said during the second-quarter earnings call.
